title: Mausoleum of Oljeitu (Dome of Soltaniyeh), Soltaniyeh
summary: The mausoleum of Oljeitu at Soltaniyeh, capital of the Ilkhanid dynasty in north-western Iran, was built between 1302 and 1312. A massive drum on an octagonal base carries a brick dome about 50 m high and 25 m across, built as a double shell. It is a key monument of Persian Islamic architecture.

uncertainty.note: Start is the first year of construction given by UCLA's Iran Gazetteer and UNESCO (1302-12); Negareh gives 704 AH for the dome's introduction and 712 AH for the tomb's erection. End is the present: the building stands.
